related.title: 北海聯網海底直流電纜
related.titleEn: North Sea Link Subsea HVDC Interconnector
related.transfer: 可遷移「可用率與輸電量」與「直流線路損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；北海聯網海底直流電纜的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Availability and energy transferred" and "DC line loss" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of North Sea Link Subsea HVDC Interconnector must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦連接英國與丹麥的最長聯網線：兩地風電的互補、啟用初期的容量限制、陸纜的接頭與溫升、磁場與埋設；北海聯網海底直流電纜則以七百二十公里的海底電纜把英國的風接上挪威的水庫：價差收入、省下的水、電纜的重量、深水敷設與最大單一事故為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the longest interconnector, joining Britain and Denmark: complementary wind, early capacity limit, land cable joints and heating, magnetic field and burial; North Sea Link Subsea HVDC Interconnector centres on A 720-kilometre subsea cable joining British wind to Norwegian reservoirs: spread income, water saved, cable weight, deep-water laying and the largest single loss, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「兩地風電的互補」與「價差與擁塞收入」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「啟用初期容量限制的影響」的模型移到北海聯網海底直流電纜，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「直流線路損失」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "How two wind fleets complement each other" and "Price spread and congestion income".
Move the model of "Effect of the early capacity limit" to North Sea Link Subsea HVDC Interconnector, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "DC line loss", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「可用率與輸電量」與「直流線路損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；北海聯網海底直流電纜的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Availability and energy transferred" and "DC line loss" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of North Sea Link Subsea HVDC Interconnector must be respecified.

related.title: 昌吉—古泉 ±1100 kV 特高壓直流
related.transfer: 可遷移「可用率與輸電量」與「直流線路損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；昌吉—古泉 ±1100 kV 特高壓直流的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Availability and energy transferred" and "DC line loss" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Changji–Guquan ±1100 kV UHVDC Link must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦連接英國與丹麥的最長聯網線：兩地風電的互補、啟用初期的容量限制、陸纜的接頭與溫升、磁場與埋設；昌吉—古泉 ±1100 kV 特高壓直流則以三千公里、一千一百千伏的直流輸電：額定電流、以輸電代替輸煤、與八百千伏的比較、閘流體閥與雙極閉鎖為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the longest interconnector, joining Britain and Denmark: complementary wind, early capacity limit, land cable joints and heating, magnetic field and burial; Changji–Guquan ±1100 kV UHVDC Link centres on three thousand kilometres at eleven hundred kilovolts DC: rated current, wire in place of coal trains, comparison with eight hundred kilovolts, thyristor valves and bipole block, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「兩地風電的互補」與「額定電流」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「啟用初期容量限制的影響」的模型移到昌吉—古泉 ±1100 kV 特高壓直流，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「可用率與輸電量」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "How two wind fleets complement each other" and "Rated current".
Move the model of "Effect of the early capacity limit" to Changji–Guquan ±1100 kV UHVDC Link, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Availability and energy transferred", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「可用率與輸電量」與「直流線路損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；昌吉—古泉 ±1100 kV 特高壓直流的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Availability and energy transferred" and "DC line loss" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Changji–Guquan ±1100 kV UHVDC Link must be respecified.
